source.title: Planning criteria and cross-border coordination of frequencies for land mobile systems in the range 29.7-470 MHz

scope_notes: Values are set by frequency band and system type, not by neighbouring country.
Scope is land mobile systems from 29.7 to 470 MHz. The document gives no value above 470 MHz or for broadcasting.
Existing bilateral or multilateral agreements remain relevant and may differ (p.2, recommends 6 on p.4). None has been checked for Finland.
Time: 10% is the stated default. Footnote 2 on p.6 says that in certain situations the 1% curves should be used for digital systems. Traficom has not yet answered which it uses (ticket 02).
The document does not say which threshold applies exactly at a band edge such as 47 MHz.
Thresholds are stated at the border-line. The document does not define the evaluation point for a sea border.
Height conversion: Annex 3 (p.10) says a 10 dB correction from 10 m to 3 m may be used for practical purposes. Annex 4 triggers are already at 3 m.
breakpoints are [distance inside the neighbouring country in km, trigger in dB(uV/m)] within ref_bw_hz.
